props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: name
props.description:
Icon source. Strings should be Uno icon classes such as `i-lucide-search`
or app-config aliases such as `icon-search`.
Non-string values can be JSX nodes or render functions.
Wrap Icon in Solid control flow instead of passing a control-flow node as `name`.

props.name: size
props.description:
Explicit icon size override. Omit to inherit the surrounding font size.
Numbers are interpreted as px.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.
